name: Chorus and a room
says: A slow three-voice chorus, a third wet, spread wide, then a short warm room: the keys widen and float without a tail.

provenance.note: Self-written for the keys lab: a candidate for his pick, read by no part yet.
provenance.sparse: liquid-space round 1: trimDb 3.2 -> 5.48 (+2.28 dB), the sparse-writing match the keys lab's round 3 left open: its level on the sparse writing (keys alone, the close grand, i9 to VImaj9, the mean of its three wetness steps) brought to the three very wet spaces' mean, -26.65 LUFS
